description: This file defines endpoint mappings for product management in a web API, including CRUD operations like listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting products. It utilizes ASP.NET Core minimal APIs with route grouping and detailed metadata annotations.

classes.name: ProductEndpoints
classes.description: Contains extension method to register product-related API endpoints on the web application.

methods.name: MapProductEndpoints
methods.description: Configures and maps all CRUD API endpoints for products under the route '/api/products', including list, get by id, create, update, and delete operations.
